VERSION 3.29.1.0

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            function openChatGPT() {
                if (!root.document || root.isLoading) return;
                toolbar.closeFoldout();
                chatGPTLoader.active = true;
                if (chatGPTLoader.status === Loader.Ready) chatGPTLoader.item.open();
            }
            // Temporary bindings restore the existing dialog expressions,
            // including other mods, when the chat closes.
            Binding {
                target: root
                property: "subDialogOpen"
                when: chatGPTLoader.item?.opened ?? false
                value: true
                restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
            }
            Binding {
                target: root
                property: "fullscreenSubDialogOpen"
                when: chatGPTLoader.item?.opened ?? false
                value: true
                restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
            }
            PenInputBlocker {
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 21000
                visible: chatGPTLoader.item?.opened ?? false
                manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager
            }
            Loader {
                id: chatGPTLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 21001
                active: false
                visible: item?.opened ?? false
                source: "file:///home/root/xovi/ChatGPT/ChatGPT.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.useNativeDisplay = true;
                    item.documentObject = Qt.binding(function() { return root.document; });
                    item.documentId = Qt.binding(function() { return root.document ? String(root.document.id) : ""; });
                    item.documentTitle = Qt.binding(function() { return root.document ? root.document.visibleName : ""; });
                    item.currentPageIndex = Qt.binding(function() { return root.currentPage; });
                    item.currentPageId = Qt.binding(function() { return String(root.currentPageId); });
                    item.pageCount = Qt.binding(function() { return root.pageCount; });
                    item.documentLoading = Qt.binding(function() { return root.isLoading; });
                    item.sceneColorProfile = Qt.binding(function() { return root.colorProfile.sceneRendering; });
                    item.reader.prepareCapture.connect(function() {
                        if (sceneController) sceneController.requestDeferredCompleted();
                    });
                    item.open();
                }
                onStatusChanged: {
                    if (status === Loader.Error) console.warn("[ChatGPT] Could not load ChatGPT.qml");
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: chatGPTLoader.item
                function onClosed() { chatGraphHandoff.abandon();sceneView.forceActiveFocus(); }
                function onOpenGraphRequested(state, context) {
                    if (typeof graphCalcLoader === "undefined" || !root.notePage || root.isLoading) {
                        chatGPTLoader.item.creations.errorMessage = "graphCalc is unavailable on this page.";
                        return;
                    }
                    chatGraphHandoff.request = {state:state,context:context,attempts:0};
                    graphCalcLoader.active = true;
                    chatGraphHandoff.restart();
                }
                function onImageReady(fileUrl, context, contentId) {
                    const chat = chatGPTLoader.item;
                    if (!root.document || root.isLoading || !sceneController ||
                            String(root.document.id) !== context.documentId ||
                            String(root.currentPageId) !== context.pageId) {
                        chat.creations.errorMessage = "The page changed. Open the preview again before inserting.";
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!root.notePage || typeof sceneController.insertImageFileAsSceneItem !== "function") {
                        chat.creations.errorMessage = "Image insertion is unavailable on this page.";
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!String(fileUrl).startsWith("file:///home/root/xovi/ChatGPT/images/content-")) {
                        chat.creations.errorMessage = "The content image is unavailable.";
                        return;
                    }
                    try {
                        const position = sceneView.viewToScene(Qt.point(sceneView.width / 2, sceneView.height / 2));
                        sceneView.endItemSelection();
                        sceneController.insertImageFileAsSceneItem(fileUrl, position);
                        chat.contentInserted(contentId);
                    } catch (error) {
                        chat.creations.errorMessage = "Could not insert content: " + error;
                    }
                }
            }
            Timer {
                id: chatGraphHandoff
                interval: 50
                property var request: null
                function abandon() {
                    if (request && typeof graphCalcLoader !== "undefined" && graphCalcLoader.item)
                        graphCalcLoader.item.opened = false;
                    stop();request = null;
                }
                onTriggered: {
                    const chat = chatGPTLoader.item, pending = request;
                    if (!pending || !chat || !chat.opened) { abandon();return; }
                    if (!root.document || root.isLoading || String(root.document.id) !== pending.context.documentId ||
                            String(root.currentPageId) !== pending.context.pageId) {
                        abandon();chat.creations.errorMessage = "The page changed. Open the preview again.";return;
                    }
                    if (graphCalcLoader.status === Loader.Error || ++pending.attempts > 200) {
                        abandon();chat.creations.errorMessage = "Could not open graphCalc.";return;
                    }
                    const calculator = graphCalcLoader.item;
                    if (!calculator || !calculator.sessionReady) { restart();return; }
                    if (typeof calculator.applyState !== "function" || typeof calculator.outputSettings !== "object") {
                        abandon();chat.creations.errorMessage = "Update graphCalc to open this graph.";return;
                    }
                    const previous = calculator.snapshot();
                    try {
                        calculator.checkpoint();
                        calculator.applyState(pending.state);
                        if (calculator.errorMessage) throw new Error(calculator.errorMessage);
                        calculator.checkpoint();
                        request = null;
                        chat.close();
                        calculator.open();
                    } catch (error) {
                        request = null;calculator.opened = false;
                        try { calculator.applyState(previous);calculator.checkpoint(); } catch (ignored) {}
                        chat.creations.errorMessage = "Could not open graph: " + error;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        TRAVERSE Item#_uiContainer
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                // This entry point is outside the native toolbar's GridLayout.
                ArkControls.ToolButton {
                    id: chatGPTButton
                    objectName: "chatGPTButton"
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.rightMargin: 24 + (toolbar.shown && toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Right ? toolbar.innerWidth : 0)
                    anchors.bottomMargin: 24 + (toolbar.shown && toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Bottom ? toolbar.innerHeight : 0)
                    width: 88
                    height: 88
                    visible: root.document && !root.subDialogOpen && !root.isLoading
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    background: Rectangle { color: chatGPTButton.down ? "black" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 1 }
                    contentItem: Text {
                        text: "GPT"
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        color: chatGPTButton.down ? "white" : "black"
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    }
                    onClicked: root.openChatGPT()
                    PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
